newsitem.title: USA: American Communications acting CFO quits.
newsitem.headline: American Communications acting CFO quits.

text.p: American Communications Services Inc said Monday that Richard Kozak, its acting chief financial officer, had quit the company, citing breach of contract.
"Mr. Kozak claims that the Company breached his employment contract as a result of a management reorganization in early December 1996," it said.
Prior to the reorganization, Kozak was president and chief executive officer.
"The company is considering its options, including terminating Mr. Kozak's employment...and the Company expects to announce the hiring of a Chief Financial Officer in the near future," it said.
